title: 第845章 前往空间裂缝第844章 大肆采购
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
桃夭夭化作的木簪在她发间轻轻晃了晃，传音出来问了一句：知初，我们回去要走哪个传送阵？东华八大宗门的跨洲传送阵速度超快，我听说一两天就能从这边抵达你说的无边海边界，特别省事！
宁知初一边往前走一边摇头回她：不走传送阵。
桃夭夭明显愣了一下：啊？为什么呀？传送阵多省事啊，不用赶路不用冒险，稳稳当当就能到地方。我以前虽然没坐过但听不少修士说过，那玩意儿跨洲跨域比御剑快几百倍呢。
宁知初放慢了脚步，耐心地跟她解释。这段话她也是说给空间里的三小只和肩头的小乌龟听的，算是把自己的决策逻辑交代清楚：东华所有跨域跨界传送阵全部掌控在八大宗门手里。我当初来的时候就是避开了传送阵走的无边海空间裂缝。
传送阵全程被大能监控，进出记录全部留档。我不想留下任何痕迹，也不想被各大宗门盯上记录行踪。我在东华游历了五十年一直低调行事，要是临走的时候在传送阵那边被人登记了姓名来历去向，那这五十年的低调就全白费了。我只是过客，不想被任何本土势力惦记。
而且无边海的空间裂缝通道我已经走过一次了，一回生二回熟，路况熟悉危险在哪怎么规避我心里门清。比走陌生的传送阵稳妥多了。传送阵看起来安稳，实际上你要经过人家的地盘、走人家的通道、被人家的阵法扫一遍，谁知道有没有留什么暗手。
肩头的小乌龟这时候慢悠悠地接了一句。它的嗓音依旧是那副不紧不慢的沙哑调子，但说的话一针见血：传送阵看似安稳，实则处处是眼线规则禁锢。无边海乱流凶险却无人管控无人窥探，最适合低调往返。你选的路线比你师父明智。
宁知初偏头看了它一眼：我师父当时是跟着官方传送阵过来的，他没得选。
小乌龟慢悠悠地了一声没有反驳。
桃夭夭在簪子里听完了整段解释，似懂非懂地琢磨了一会儿然后开口说：原来是这样！我懂了！就是不想被本地大能盯上低调跑路最安全！那我听你的，你怎么走我就怎么走！反正我只是一根簪子你说去哪我去哪。
宁知初被她那句低调跑路逗得笑了一下：也不算跑路，就是归乡。走吧，我们直接动身，直奔当初来时的绝灵荒漠。
接下来的路程她提速了。如今她是渡劫巅峰修为，身法速度远超初来东华之时。她连飞剑都懒得祭出来，仅凭肉身凌空踏步就能在天地之间如一道流光般穿梭。跨洲越域不过片刻功夫，她还刻意压着速度免得弄出太大的灵力波动引起注意，但即便如此也已经快得足以让沿途任何试图窥探的修士连她的影子都捕捉不到。
一路畅通无阻。
没用多久她就再次踏入了那片熟悉的绝灵荒漠。
黄沙，灰天，惨白的太阳悬在正中央一动不动。空气中没有一丝灵气波动，地面上没有任何活物的痕迹。天地寂寥空旷得如同一张被人忘记收起的旧画布，颜色单调到了极致。
时隔数十年再次踏足此地，宁知初半点陌生感都没有。她熟门熟路地朝着荒漠深处走去，脚下踩出的沙印被风一吹就散了，整片荒漠沉默地接纳了她的再次归来。当初第一次来这里的时候她还需要徒步走很远再换神识飞行才能横穿，如今她仅凭肉身身法不需要灵力就能在沙地上掠出一道残影，片刻之间便横跨了大半区域精准锁定了当初那道空间裂缝的入口。
那片灰蒙蒙的空域依旧安静地悬浮在荒漠深处，雾状的混沌气息在虚无中缓缓翻涌着。入口处跟上次来的时候几乎一模一样，连那些翻涌的雾纹走向都没怎么变过。空间裂缝的时间感和外界不太一样，五十年对它来说大概只是打了个盹的工夫。
宁知初在裂缝入口前停下脚步转身扫了一圈四周——入目只有无垠的黄沙和苍白的天光，没有任何异样。她确定身后没有任何跟踪者之后才转回身来面对着那片混沌的空域。
马上要进空间裂缝了。她开口说，声音不大但传音给发间的桃夭夭听得很清楚，里面是空间乱流没有任何规则凶险极大，一不小心就会被撕碎神魂肉身。你没有经验第一次进这种地方，为了稳妥起见你保持簪子形态别在我发髻上依附我身，这样最安全。
桃夭夭在簪子里应声回得又快又干脆：好！我听你的！我本体是草木灵体化作木簪最隐蔽，不会拖你后腿还能随时帮你调动木系灵气护身！虽然里面没有灵气可以调动但我可以调集自身储备的木灵之力，关键时候给你续一口总归是好的。

话音落下她本就收敛到极致的气息又往深处沉了一分，整支桃木簪通体温润散发着淡淡的草木清香，彻底融入宁知初的发髻之中看不出半点异常来。
宁知初检查了一遍确认隐匿完美然后偏头看向肩头的小乌龟。那只拳头大的小玄龟依旧稳稳当当地趴着，脑袋缩在壳里只露出一个圆溜溜的鼻尖，姿态安详得跟在外头晒太阳没什么区别。
前辈，还是麻烦你继续指路。乱流路线只有你最熟。她语气里带着一点不放心，这次我虽然修为涨了不少能多避开一些乱流，但有些危险我自己还是看不出来。
小乌龟慢悠悠地睁开一只眼看了她一下，然后以它一贯的不紧不慢的语速说了六个字：照旧，无需紧张。然后顿了顿，补了三个字，死不了。
宁知初失笑：我不紧张，就是怕你依旧慢半拍提醒。上次在裂缝里你每次都说头顶躲左边避的时候我已经躲完了。
小乌龟的表情没什么变化，语气依旧平淡：此次你修为大增，也能避开些许乱流，有的不需要提醒。自己看得见的危险无需多言，真正致命的我自然会提前开口。
宁知初听完彻底无奈了：行吧，您说了算。
她把周身护体屏障又加固了一层，神识调集到最紧绷的状态，芥子空间的视野通道打开好让三小只全程看到外面情况。小岚只只和小青在空间里各自就位，安静地蹲在视野通道前面等着。
一切准备就绪。
content_en:
The wooden hairpin transformed by Tao Yaoyao swayed gently in her hair, and a voice came out to ask: Zhichu, which teleportation array should we take when we go back? The cross-continental teleportation array of the eight major sects of Donghua is super fast. I heard that you can reach the border of the boundless sea from here in one or two days, which is very trouble-free!
Ning Zhichu shook his head and replied to her as he walked forward: "I won't go through the teleportation array."
Tao Yaoyao was obviously stunned for a moment: Huh? Why? The teleportation array is so trouble-free. You don't have to rush and take risks. You can get to the place safely. Although I have never ridden one before, I have heard many monks say that that thing can travel across continents and regions hundreds of times faster than a sword.
Ning Zhichu slowed down and explained to her patiently. She also said this to the three little ones in the space and the little turtle on her shoulder, which made her decision-making logic clear: all cross-domain and cross-border teleportation formations in Donghua are controlled by the eight major sects. When I first came here, I avoided the space cracks in the boundless sea where the teleportation array went.
The whole process of the teleportation array is monitored by the powerful, and all entries and exits are recorded. I don't want to leave any traces, and I don't want to be watched by the major sects and record my whereabouts. I have been traveling in Donghua for fifty years and kept a low profile. If my name, whereabouts and whereabouts were registered at the teleportation array before I left, then all these fifty years of keeping a low profile would be in vain. I'm just a passerby and don't want to be missed by any local forces.
Moreover, I have walked through the space crack channel of the boundless sea once, and it is familiar to me once and twice. I am familiar with the road conditions and know where the dangers are and how to avoid them. It is much safer than taking an unfamiliar teleportation array. The teleportation array looks stable, but in fact you have to pass through other people's territory, walk through other people's passages, and be scanned by other people's formations. Who knows if there are any hidden tricks left behind.
The little turtle on the shoulder answered slowly at this time. Its voice still had the same unhurried and hoarse tone, but what it said hit the nail on the head: the teleportation array seemed stable, but in fact it was restricted by eyeliner rules everywhere. The boundless sea is turbulent and dangerous, but it is uncontrolled and unnoticed, making it the perfect place to travel in a low-key manner. You have chosen a wiser course than your master.
Ning Zhichu turned his head and glanced at it: My master came here with the official teleportation array, he had no choice.
The little turtle said slowly without any retort.
Tao Yaoyao listened to the entire explanation in her hairpin, thought about it for a while, and then said: So that's it! I understand! I just don’t want to be targeted by local powerful people, so it’s safest to run away in a low profile! Then I listen to you, I will go as you go! Anyway, I'm just a hairpin. I'll go wherever you say.
Ning Zhichu was amused by her low-key words about running away: It's not running away, it's just returning home. Let's go, let's set off directly and head straight to the Jueling Desert where we first came.
She speeded up the rest of the way. Now she is at the peak level of transcending tribulation, and her movement speed is far faster than when she first came to Donghua. She didn't even bother to use her flying sword. She could travel between heaven and earth like a stream of light just by stepping in the air with her body. It only took a moment to cross continents and territories, and she deliberately kept her speed low so as not to cause too much spiritual power fluctuations to attract attention, but even so, she was fast enough that any monks who tried to pry along the way could not even catch her shadow.
The journey was smooth.
It didn't take long for her to step into the familiar desert desert again.
Yellow sand, gray sky, and the pale sun hung motionless in the center. There was not a trace of spiritual energy fluctuations in the air, and there were no traces of any living creatures on the ground. The world is as lonely and empty as an old canvas that has been forgotten to be put away, and the colors are extremely monotonous.
After setting foot here again after decades, Ning Zhichu didn’t feel any strangeness at all. She walked towards the depths of the desert in a familiar way, and the sand prints left under her feet were blown away by the wind, and the entire desert silently accepted her return. When she first came here, she still had to walk a long way and then use her spiritual consciousness to fly to cross. Now she can just use her physical body and body skills without spiritual power to sweep out a path on the sand.An afterimage spread across most of the area in a moment and accurately locked onto the entrance to the space crack.
The gray airspace was still suspended quietly in the depths of the desert, and the mist-like chaotic atmosphere was slowly surging in the void. The entrance is almost exactly the same as the last time I came here, and even the direction of the surging fog patterns has not changed much. The sense of time in the space rift is different from that in the outside world. For it, fifty years is probably just a nap.
Ning Zhichu stopped in front of the entrance of the crack, turned around and scanned the surroundings - there was only boundless yellow sand and pale skylight, nothing out of the ordinary. After she made sure there was no follower behind her, she turned back to face the chaotic airspace.
We are about to enter a space rift. She spoke, but her voice was not loud but the sound was transmitted to Tao Yaoyao who heard clearly. There was turbulence in the space without any rules and it was extremely dangerous. If you were not careful, your soul and body would be torn apart. You have no experience entering this kind of place for the first time. To be on the safe side, keep the hairpin in my bun and attach it to me. This is the safest way.
Tao Yaoyao replied quickly and simply in her hairpin: OK! I listen to you! My true body is the spiritual body of plants and trees, transformed into a wooden hairpin, which is the most concealed. I will not hold you back and can help you mobilize the wood spiritual energy to protect you at any time! Although there is no spiritual energy in it to mobilize, I can mobilize the power of the wood spirit that I have reserved. It is always good to give you a refill at a critical moment.
As she finished speaking, her breath, which was already extremely restrained, sank a little deeper. The whole peach wood hairpin was moist and exuded a faint fragrance of vegetation, and it completely blended into Ning Zhichu's bun without any abnormalities.
Ning Zhichu checked to make sure the concealment was perfect and then turned his head to look at the little turtle on his shoulder. The little black turtle as big as a fist was still lying firmly on its stomach, with its head retracted in its shell and only the tip of its round nose exposed. Its posture was as peaceful as if it were basking in the sun outside.
Senior, I would like to trouble you to continue to guide me. Only you are familiar with turbulent flow routes. There was a bit of worry in her tone. Although my cultivation level has improved a lot this time and I can avoid more turbulence, there are some dangers that I still can't see.
The little turtle slowly opened one eye and looked at her, and then said six words at his usual unhurried speaking speed: As usual, no need to be nervous. Then he paused and added three words, "I can't die."
Ning Zhichu burst out laughing: I'm not nervous, I'm just afraid that you'd still be slow to remind me. Last time in the crack, you told me to hide with my head and to the left every time. I had already finished hiding.
The little turtle's expression did not change, and his tone remained calm: This time your cultivation level has greatly increased, and you can avoid some turbulence, some of which do not need to be reminded. There is no need to say anything about the danger that I can see. The real fatal thing is that I will naturally speak in advance.
Ning Zhichu was completely helpless after hearing this: Okay, you have the final say.
She reinforced the protective barrier around her body by another layer, mobilized her consciousness to its tightest state, and opened the vision channel in the mustard space so that the three little ones could see the outside situation at all times. Xiaolan and Xiaoqing just took their respective positions in the space, squatting quietly in front of the viewing channel and waiting.
Everything is ready.
